This is a logic puzzle. There are 7 houses (numbered 1 on the left, 7 on the right), from the perspective of someone standing across the street from them. Each has a different person in them. They have different characteristics:
 - Each person has a unique name: alice, emily, bob, eric, carol, arnold, david
 - They all have a different favorite flower: daffodils, lilies, iris, tulips, roses, carnations, orchid
 - Each person has a favorite color: brown, yellow, purple, green, white, red, blue
 - Each person has a favorite drink: root beer, water, milk, boba tea, coffee, wine, tea
 - Everyone has something different for lunch: sushi, stew, stir fry, soup, spaghetti, pizza, grilled cheese
 - Everyone has a favorite smoothie: butterscotch, desert, lilac, darkness, lemon, life, dragonfruit
 - Each mother is accompanied by their child: timothy, meredith, samantha, billy, fred, alice, bella

1. The person who is a pizza lover is the Lemon smoothie lover.
2. The person who loves the sushi is the person who is the mother of Timothy.
3. The person who loves white is Carol.
4. The Lilac smoothie drinker is the one who only drinks water.
5. The Butterscotch smoothie drinker is the person who likes milk.
6. The person who loves purple is the Darkness smoothie drinker.
7. The person whose favorite color is red is Bob.
8. David is the person who loves purple.
9. The person's child is named Alice is in the second house.
10. The person's child is named Meredith is in the third house.
11. The person who loves a bouquet of daffodils is the Lilac smoothie drinker.
12. The person's child is named Meredith is the one who only drinks water.
13. The person's child is named Fred is the person who loves eating grilled cheese.
14. The person who loves white is the Lemon smoothie lover.
15. The person who loves a carnations arrangement is Alice.
16. The person who loves the rose bouquet is the person who loves stir fry.
17. Alice is the person who likes milk.
18. The person who loves blue is the root beer lover.
19. The person who loves brown is the person who loves the soup.
20. The boba tea drinker is the person who loves the vase of tulips.
21. The Life smoothie drinker is directly left of Bob.
22. The person who loves yellow and the root beer lover are next to each other.
23. The Life smoothie drinker is the root beer lover.
24. Bob is in the sixth house.
25. The boba tea drinker is the person's child is named Bella.
26. The person who loves the boquet of lilies is directly left of the tea drinker.
27. Emily is the person who loves the boquet of iris.
28. The person who loves the sushi is in the seventh house.
29. The person's child is named Meredith is the person who loves the stew.
30. The Dragonfruit smoothie lover is the person who is the mother of Billy.
31. The person's child is named Fred is the coffee drinker.
32. The person who loves yellow is Eric.

What is Name of the person who lives in House 1?? Provide only the name of the person as your final answer.

IMPORTANT: When you finish, put ONLY the final answer inside \boxed{...} (no extra text). If the task requests a multi-line format, encode it into a single line representation.

This is a logic puzzle. There are 7 houses (numbered 1 on the left, 7 on the right), from the perspective of someone standing across the street from them. Each has a different person in them. They have different characteristics:
 - Each person has a unique name: alice, emily, bob, eric, carol, arnold, david
 - They all have a different favorite flower: daffodils, lilies, iris, tulips, roses, carnations, orchid
 - Each person has a favorite color: brown, yellow, purple, green, white, red, blue
 - Each person has a favorite drink: root beer, water, milk, boba tea, coffee, wine, tea
 - Everyone has something different for lunch: sushi, stew, stir fry, soup, spaghetti, pizza, grilled cheese
 - Everyone has a favorite smoothie: butterscotch, desert, lilac, darkness, lemon, life, dragonfruit
 - Each mother is accompanied by their child: timothy, meredith, samantha, billy, fred, alice, bella

1. The person who is a pizza lover is the Lemon smoothie lover.
2. The person who loves the sushi is the person who is the mother of Timothy.
3. The person who loves white is Carol.
4. The Lilac smoothie drinker is the one who only drinks water.
5. The Butterscotch smoothie drinker is the person who likes milk.
6. The person who loves purple is the Darkness smoothie drinker.
7. The person whose favorite color is red is Bob.
8. David is the person who loves purple.
9. The person's child is named Alice is in the second house.
10. The person's child is named Meredith is in the third house.
11. The person who loves a bouquet of daffodils is the Lilac smoothie drinker.

13. The person's child is named Fred is the person who loves eating grilled cheese.
14. The person who loves white is the Lemon smoothie lover.
15. The person who loves a carnations arrangement is Alice.
16. The person who loves the rose bouquet is the person who loves stir fry.
17. Alice is the person who likes milk.
18. The person who loves blue is the root beer lover.
19. The person who loves brown is the person who loves the soup.
20. The boba tea drinker is the person who loves the vase of tulips.
21. The Life smoothie drinker is directly left of Bob.
22. The person who loves yellow and the root beer lover are next to each other.
23. The Life smoothie drinker is the root beer lover.
24. Bob is in the sixth house.
25. The boba tea drinker is the person's child is named Bella.
26. The person who loves the boquet of lilies is directly left of the tea drinker.
27. Emily is the person who loves the boquet of iris.
28. The person who loves the sushi is in the seventh house.
29. The person's child is named Meredith is the person who loves the stew.
30. The Dragonfruit smoothie lover is the person who is the mother of Billy.

32. The person who loves yellow is Eric.

What is Name of the person who lives in House 1?? Provide only the name of the person as your final answer.
